cards.title: Gate server-side Meta events on consent
cards.claim: The setup sends Meta Conversion API events only when consent is granted.
cards.action: Configure the page-view and contact-event triggers with a consent condition before sending data to Meta.
applies_when: Sending page-view or contact events from a server-side container to Meta
do_not_use_when: The consent condition has not been implemented or verified
unknowns: The passage does not define the consent-mode variable implementation.
The passage does not specify which consent categories or jurisdictions apply.
evidence_quotes: "it's really important that you don't send information to Facebook if there is no consent given"
"we need to add a rule to make it consent only"
"it's really important to only send data into meta ads as long as there is consent given"

cards.title: Use a debug-mode test ID variable for Conversion API testing
cards.claim: A lookup-table variable can supply the Meta test event code only in debug mode and remain empty by default.
cards.action: Set the test ID through a lookup table with an empty default value and the test event code when debug mode is true.
applies_when: Testing Conversion API events in preview/debug mode
Using Meta Events Manager test events
do_not_use_when: The current Meta test event code has changed and the lookup-table value has not been updated
unknowns: The passage does not specify how long a test event code remains valid.
The passage does not establish whether the described GTM configuration works in every implementation.
evidence_quotes: "as a default value the default value is empty so by default there is no test ID"
"that's when debug mode is set to true"
"every time I'm in preview mode so that means that this window here is open that will set this value to true then I'm going to use a test ID"
"if you set the test ID today and you want to test tomorrow chances are that the test ID has changed"

cards.title: Verify browser and server events, then deduplicate
cards.claim: When the browser pixel and Conversion API both send the same event, Meta can show one browser event and one server event; the passage says an event ID is needed to avoid double counting.
cards.action: Check Events Manager for the browser and server versions of tested events, then implement event-ID-based deduplication before considering the setup finished.
applies_when: The same page-view or conversion event is sent through both the browser pixel and Conversion API
do_not_use_when: Only one event source is sending the event
An event-ID implementation has not been fully configured and tested
unknowns: The passage ends before providing the complete event-ID configuration.
The exact event-ID template settings and matching rules are not provided.
evidence_quotes: "we just measured two page View events one from the browser and one from the server"
"I have a contact event from the server and I have a contact event from the browser"
"we need to D duplicate these events"
"we're doing that through an event ID"
